headline: Midnight chaos: Gunfire, looting, and vandalism hit Dhaka
summary: A wave of violence swept through the capital during the night, leaving a trail of destruction across the city.
details: Dhaka experienced a midnight rampage characterized by gunfire, widespread looting, and vandalism.
The violence broke out suddenly, targeting various properties and causing significant damage across the city.
Reports indicate that multiple locations were hit by mobs, leading to the destruction of assets and theft of goods.
Security forces are working to restore order as the city recovers from the overnight unrest.

headline_marked: Clash over drug trade control in [[two groups fight in Chittagong]]
headline: Clash over drug trade control in two groups fight in Chittagong
summary: Followers of Murad and Jasim clashed in Baklia, causing panic among locals as explosions and loud noises were heard.
details: A violent clash broke out between two rival groups in the Baklia area of Chittagong city on Sunday night around 11 PM.
The conflict, centered on the control of the local drug trade, involved followers of Murad and Jasim, according to Baklia Police Station OC Shahinur Alam.
Witnesses reported seeing the groups chase each other with sticks and sharp weapons, while loud explosions and sounds resembling gunfire were heard.
The police have clarified that no actual gunfire took place; instead, firecrackers were used and stones were thrown at tin roofs, creating loud noises that caused widespread panic.
Several people from both sides were injured in the clash, though police stated that none of the injuries were serious.
Law enforcement agencies are currently conducting operations to arrest those involved in the violence.
caption:
Explosions and loud noises spark panic in Chittagong as rival drug gangs clash.

A violent clash broke out between two rival groups in the Baklia area of Chittagong city on Sunday night around 11 PM.

The conflict, centered on the control of the local drug trade, involved followers of Murad and Jasim, according to Baklia Police Station OC Shahinur Alam.

Witnesses reported seeing the groups chase each other with sticks and sharp weapons, while loud explosions and sounds resembling gunfire were heard.

The police have clarified that no actual gunfire took place; instead, firecrackers were used and stones were thrown at tin roofs, creating loud noises that caused widespread panic.

Several people from both sides were injured in the clash, though police stated that none of the injuries were serious.

Law enforcement agencies are currently conducting operations to arrest those involved in the violence.

#Chittagong #Bangladesh #CrimeNews #Baklia #LawAndOrder

Source: Prothom Alo
